title: UEREMCP Request Envelope
description: The single JSON object every agent-facing UEREMCP tool accepts. Frozen by ADR-0003. Domain workstreams extend `specification` ONLY — never the envelope. Owned by WS-01.

action.description: The goal-level operation, e.g. create_niagara_effect, replace_blueprint_graph, execute_plan. Selects which schema under schemas/domains/ validates `specification`. Registered actions are listed in docs/CAPABILITY_CATALOG.md.

target.description: What the operation acts on. Omit for pure-create operations that derive their path from `specification` (ADR-0006 rule 1).

graph_id.description: Graph within the asset, e.g. EventGraph. Required for graph-scoped actions.

actor_label.description: For level-scoped operations targeting a placed actor.

specification.description: THE ONLY DOMAIN-EXTENSIBLE FIELD. Shape is selected by `action` and defined by the owning workstream under schemas/domains/<domain>/. Validated in two passes: envelope first, then the action-specific schema.

dry_run.description: Plan and execute inside a sandbox, report the full result, then discard (ADR-0005 rule 5). NOT a separate no-op code path — a dry run that exercises different code predicts nothing. Destructive actions default this to true; see docs/adr/ADR-0010 when written.

atomic.description: Run inside a single FGlobalSandbox scope so the whole operation persists or discards together.

rollback_on_failure.description: Discard the sandbox on failure. With atomic:false, partial results may be persisted and the response is partially_completed.

validate.description: Setting false forfeits any *_validated status. The response will report partially_completed instead (AGENTS.md rule 6).

timeout_ms.description: 0 or omitted means the service default. Exceeding it yields partially_completed with a job handle, never a silent truncation.

continue_on_error.description: Batch only. Attempt independent operations after a failure instead of stopping.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency guard (ADR-0006). If it does not match current state, options.on_revision_conflict decides. Omit to skip the check — acceptable for creates, risky for modifications in a multi-agent project.

idempotency_key.description: Retry deduplication (ADR-0006 rule 3). A repeat within the retention window returns the stored response with metrics.replayed = true and performs no work.
